name: healthcare-assistant
description: Healthcare assistant: read-only patient-record lookup with the strictest evidence posture. Region and consent rules apply before any connector executes.

tools.name: patient_record_lookup
tools.description: Read patient records from the clinical system (read-only, consent-gated).

notes: GDPR/health data requires consent records — create consent before connector execution (POST /v1/governance/consents).
Every action requires human approval; the agent never acts on clinical data unattended.
